intent: Extend repository-backed continuity and capability governance with a bounded remote-only worker cursor, automatic next-invocation interruption recovery, turn-boundary S+H, typed cross-workstream delivery contracts, and conflict-free immutable Drive database generations.
rationale_summary: CAP-0009 already owns bounded fresh-Agent recovery, live-head reconciliation and data-plane handoff; CAP-0010 already owns sparse governance routing and semantic-owner uniqueness. Worker interruption, shared Drive database and ownership gaps fit their extension seams and do not require a new semantic owner.
